patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.chiefComplaint: Drunk, fell and cut his head
clinical.quoteLong: I had a few too many and tripped, cut my forehead on the coffee table. It bled a lot. I didn't black out that I know of. Head hurts where I hit it but I feel okay otherwise.
clinical.presentationShort: 50yo M — intoxicated, forehead laceration from a fall, GCS 15, no LOC reported; laceration needs repair, needs sober reassessment for occult injury.
clinical.presentationLong: 50-year-old intoxicated male with a forehead laceration from a fall, GCS 15 without reported loss of consciousness, requiring wound repair and sober reassessment to exclude occult head injury.

diagnosis.disposition: Fast Track → wound repair, tetanus, glucose, observe, reassess when sober, consider CT (intoxication + head strike); discharge when safe.
diagnosis.why: Intoxicated + head strike = don't just fix the cut. Watch, reassess sober, and have a low threshold to CT the head.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: seated, holding gauze to his forehead
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 50-year-old man, disheveled, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: holding a gauze pad to his forehead. Expression: bleary and sheepish. Clearly visible: a gauze pad held to the forehead and a disheveled look. No text, no logos.
